_doc: AUTHORITATIVE RELEASE-STATE CONTRACT (final integration 2026-07-21, integration/v2.11-final-rc). Binds the config identity together with the release identities, the owner-approved switch posture, the PVC provenance and the must-be-unset override hooks. Loaded + fail-closed in a canonical build (release_contract.verify). PROVISIONAL final-RC; no tag/deploy/canonical-score authorised.

held_candidates.reason: The ruled pricing split (national curve 1-64, everything past 64 into the pool) rebuilt the board in the tree. The board move is deliberately NOT made: no balanced reference, no UI bundles, no history column - one column is written per LANDED change, and this baseline effort gets its single column when the whole of it lands. The shipped UI bundle still stamps the released board. Cleared at owner adoption, in the same commit that re-stamps identities.board and removes this declaration.
engine/rl_after/_merged_recover.py carries the split + Addendum-1 fit-site changes that produced the held candidate board. Same hold, same adoption commit.
engine/rl_after/rl_model.py carries the same split work. Same hold, same adoption commit.

The ruled vocabulary replacement (K-FWD/KFWD/KEY_FWD -> KPF, K-DEF/KDEF/KEY_DEF -> KPD, G-DEF/GDEF/GEN_DEF -> SD, G-FWD/GFWD/GEN_FWD -> SF, RUC/RUCK -> RUCK, and the pre-262 DEF->GEN_DEF back-catalogue alias resolved to SD) rewrote every position value in engine/rl_after/rl_model_data.json: 6,365 field values across drafted/present/future/alternate_position and the eligibilities string, plus one prose correction note under owner ruling R2-4, plus the new per-season eligibility key on all 11,264 scoring records (owner ruling R3-1 DEFERRED the 62 position-field edits to the re-derivation job, so the position fields themselves are byte-identical to pre-262 modulo the vocabulary relabel). NO other store field moved and no scoring array was touched - verified field-by-field against the pre-migration store. The store and the release were previously in agreement, so this is a NEW declaration rather than a re-stamp: the shipped bundle still speaks the pre-262 vocabulary per the #217 hold. Cleared at owner adoption, in the same commit that re-stamps identities.store and removes this declaration.

Seven of the eight imported engine/forward_valuation sources carry position-code literals and were migrated to the new vocabulary in the same pass, which necessarily moves the source-set tree hash. No valuation math was changed - the stage-1 board is byte-identical to the pre-migration board modulo the relabel (103,146 scalar cells compared, 0 differences, 0 value movers, 0 rank movers). Like the store, fv and the release previously agreed, so this is a NEW declaration. Same hold, same adoption commit.

_held_candidates_doc: #251 part A, owner ruling 2026-07-29. A DECLARED held candidate is a field where the TREE deliberately runs ahead of what is RELEASED. Each entry pins BOTH sides, so only that exact pair is excused; move either side and the gate HALTs again. An UNDECLARED mismatch HALTs exactly as before. These declarations live inside the contract, so contract_sha256 covers them - one cannot be added without re-stamping. AT ADOPTION: re-stamp identities.<field> to the candidate value and DELETE that entry in the same commit. Removal is self-enforcing, not a convention: once the two sides agree, a surviving declaration excuses nothing and is itself a rejection naming the field.

season_metadata.class: A (live valuation semantics): calendar_progress + exposure_pace are DERIVED dynamic release state that FEED the valuation, stamped via rl_model+board md5 + the season_state derivation; as_of_round is the dynamic round stamp; RL_SEASON_ROUNDS is class-B ingestion infra (never a valuation input).
season_metadata.note: calendar_progress + exposure_pace are DERIVED (season_state.json); RL_M3_FE/RL_EXPO_F removed from config; derivation policy immutable (derivation_policy_id).
season_metadata.calendar_progress_derivation: round_half_up(100*as_of_round/season_total_rounds)/100 in season_state.py (policy immutable, hashed by derivation_policy_id). Consumed everywhere the engine formerly read the frozen SEASON_PROG literal + RL_M3_FE (both removed). DERIVED + advances weekly; FEEDS the valuation.
season_metadata.exposure_pace_derivation: round(median(current games of the durable population, prior>=18)/22, 3), cap 1.0; per-player scope s=clip(1-g/11,0,1). Freshly DERIVED from the staged store each round; replaces RL_EXPO_F.
season_metadata.coupling_finding: as_of_round (dynamic weekly) and the valuation season fraction are now COUPLED: the weekly updater DERIVES + ADVANCES calendar_progress and exposure_pace from the staged store each accepted round and commits them atomically with the store/board/expected_boot/contract. Round progression drives valuation progression; there is no frozen SEASON_PROG and nothing is deferred.
